# Momentum Fitness NYC

> > Momentum Fitness is a boutique Upper West Side gym specializing in personal training, small group fitness classes, and kettlebell training with no membership fees.

Founded by Marco Guanilo (Senior RKC Instructor), Momentum Fitness offers an 8,000 sq ft studio featuring strength & conditioning, yoga, Pilates, and personalized coaching. All programs include complimentary fitness assessments using InBody 570 body composition analysis and Functional Movement Screening (FMS).

## Key Topics

- Upper West Side (UWS) location
- Personal training with complimentary sessions
- Small group fitness classes (8-10 participants)
- Kettlebell training & Russian Kettlebell Challenge (RKC)
- Functional Movement Screening (FMS)
- InBody 570 body composition analysis
- No membership fees model
- Strength & conditioning programs
- NASM & ACE certified trainers
- Corrective exercise & movement screening
- Yoga, Pilates & Barre classes
- Prenatal & postnatal training
- HIIT & functional fitness
- Olympic lifting (USAW)
